g.text: Spatial Atlas computes facts before it answers a spatial question.
This research prototype has preliminary operational evidence. The recorded V37 smoke does not establish answer accuracy.
The analyst still interprets that evidence.
Spatial Atlas explores the next question.
How can an agent compute useful facts
before it explains a scene to the user?
The user needs an inspectable answer.
The user asks a spatial question.
The client receives a result and status.
The answer can still be wrong.
Four paths produced eight rows each.
The MLE handler is a separate branch.
The A2A dispatcher also selects ML tasks.
That handler generates an ML pipeline.
It needs opt-in and worker attestation.
Its attempts and execution are bounded.
These controls are not a full sandbox.
The next research step remains open.
Protected scoring must test the answers.
A native persistent kernel is proposed.
It does not prove which facts the
The application path uses a familiar client, server and response interaction.
The same model client supplies configured Fast, Standard and Strong tiers.
The tier names describe roles. They need not select different models.
The self-grade is not calibrated confidence.
The formatter does not verify factual correctness.
The task store is in memory.
It is not a durable job database.
The ordinary A2A wrapper does not supply the strict QSpatial protocol and sample metadata.
The evaluation path below has its own entry. Its repeated handler uses the same underlying code.
The recorded V37 evaluation exercises a separate, frozen four-path entry.
The scenegraph uses the correct image.
The question-only arm withholds the image.
The metric arms use either the correct image or a shuffled image.
Only the metric arms follow the perception boxes above.
The strict route never silently switches to estimated scene coordinates.
The generic metric engine has a separate fallback behavior.
The terminal finalizer verifies lifecycle closure, not answer correctness.
Harbormaster connects through a shared research question about evidence. This board claims no deployed connection between the projects.
